items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, hearing protection ... 
 etc.

Isolate the vessel from the feed water 
 system.

Be sure that the heater has been 
 completely drained.

Check the pressure gauge shows zero 
 pressure.

Check thermometers and assure that 
 temperature is less than 40 C.

Provide adequate scaffolding, lighting, 
 platforms or ladders.

Make certain that all safety tags are replaced when maintenance and 
 inspection are complete.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags. etc)

Manual puller, 4x6 
 hard wood blocks
Micro meter
Main crane, Temporary jack
Arc-air gouging

Check any leakage of 
 the flange.

Check level of water 
 in the shell side.

Check Temperature in 
 and Temperature out.

Follow the shut down 
 procedure. After the tube side has been drained the channel cover and plate 
 cover should be removed to expose the tube end.

A hydraulic test should 
 then be put on the shell side not exceeding the test pressure illustrated in 
 the technical specification.

Observe any leak which 
 occurs and mark their location, if there it is necessary to replace the tube 
 or plug both tube's ends.
